text: Hey, Mr. Station Master!\nIsn’t this the Wild Area?\r\nWhat’re we stopped here for?[VAR 0114(0005)]

Yes...
This is the Wild Area Station, make no mistake.\c
I’m sorry to tell you that the train is halted, due
to a flock of Wooloo on the tracks.
What’s there to be sorry about?\nThis is brilliant![VAR 0114(0005)]

This Wild Area is massive!
There are loads of Pokémon to battle here!\c
You get it, don’t you, [VAR 0100(0000)]?
This is the best possible place to put together
the greatest team![VAR 0114(0005)]

We can get you back to Wedgehurst, if you like.
But Motostoke is off the menu for now.\c
It wouldn’t be very decent of us to try to drive
off those Pokémon just because we happen to
want to run our train here, now would it?
